name: MT200 PIE (blue + red, 40 MHz)
source: From SymPhoTime 64 2.8's PIE.pus on the MT200 PC FK03-PC-PC118 (desktop shortcut, 2026-10-28). Sync divider: not in the .pus; at the 40 MHz sync the HydraHarp 400 needs at least 4 (measured). Detectors on HydraHarp inputs 1 and 3 (phacq inputs 0 and 2). SymPhoTime pulse mode 1 (PIE). TCSPC settings are the same in every MT200 profile: 32 ps bins (binning 5, as in the PIE profiles), sync CFD 350 mV / offset 5000 ps, detectors 250 mV with their offsets (input 0: +130 ps from PIE.pus, input 2: -40 ps from Standard.pus).

laser.pie_note: The SOM-D's PIE sequence for this profile has not been recorded yet; record it when SymPhoTime applies PIE.pus.

shutters.label: MT200 shutters

power_diode.note: raw 234 at 47 % red (CAN, 2026-10-28); SymPhoTime showed 189.5 a.u. there (UsrPowerDiode): the a.u. scale is not calibrated yet

shutters.note: MT200 shutter box on the PEAK PCAN-PCIe card (libphacq docs/mt200_shutter.md); Det 3 and Det 4 are not fitted. The box's own buttons override software control.

scanner.note: The MT200's PI E-725 piezo stage through libphacq's pi driver: "" opens the first E-725 (on Windows through PI's own USB driver and GCS library, which the unit stays bound to; on macOS and Linux over libusb); "sim:" is the simulator. Learning 5 s and a 20 ms turnaround are SymPhoTime's "fast" scans (libphacq docs/pi_e725_scanner.md).

experiment.note: Detector 0/2 assignment follows MT200 inputs 1/3; confirm dye-to-detector assignment experimentally. The 25 ns split is provisional, derived from the 2026-10-30 20 MHz recording; inspect and calibrate excitation windows before interpreting PIE stoichiometry.
